heading: LIVE deadline heap
text:
### LIVE deadline heap [LDTL.5.4]

The deadline heap exists only under `dynamic_ttl`. Its presence or absence is
what separates the two LIVE tick paths.

In LIVE **without** `dynamic_ttl`: there is no heap, and the TTL tick is
O(expired × log n_ttl_schemas + n_ttl_schemas) ([LDTL.6.1]). What the engine
reserves before the transition to LIVE is each schema's TTL queue ([LDTL.3.1]),
not a heap.

In LIVE **with** `dynamic_ttl`: the engine reserves the heap before the
transition to LIVE, inserting a deadline is O(log N_ttl), and the TTL tick is
O(expired × log N_ttl) ([LDTL.4.2]).

Both paths are bounded and neither allocates during LIVE, which is what
[RTCT.12.4] requires of the pump.
